Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-01a.html.text: Katenar: I am sorry to have kept you waiting. My name is Katenar -- have you heard of me? Thank you for agreeing to meet me in such a remote place. I am being pursued and must take every precaution I can. I think we are safe for the moment, in any event. What do wish to ask me?

links.text: "What are you doing in a place like this?"

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-01z.html.text: Katenar: Unfortunately, the timing simply isn't optimal. I hope we will be able to meet again, but this is not the time or place.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-09z.html.text: Katenar: Ah, we meet again. But as you can see, I am occupied with other matters -- and you are pressed for time as well. Seek Harkilgamed, who is hiding in Saint's Valley .

Q00068_SagaOfTheSoulHound/4-010.htm.text: Katenar: His goal is to prevent the Kamael from regaining their rightful innate power. All the problems you've had stem from his efforts, in fact. Here is what he dropped when he fled. Take it -- you'll need it. Ah, I see that you're wondering whether you will achieve the same level of power I have…

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-02a.html.text: Katenar: Hmm, I see that wizard has put you in a bad mood. I too am extremely busy, you must understand. My kind are very different from you.

links.text: Tell him that you both look the same on the outside.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-03a.html.text: Katenar: Perhaps. However, my 2 brethren and I are different beings than you. Can you not perceive the difference? The truth is, that is the reason I agreed to meet with you. It is important that you understand that despite the similarities, we are fundamentally different. Nor is it simply a matter…

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-04a.html.text: Katenar: Do you still not understand? It is the truth! You must have felt it in your journey. Why do our ancient ones not decay, physically or mentally? How is it that even compared to the other elders, Kekropus has lived so long -- ten thousand years and more, an unimaginable span even for those s…

links.text: Tell him to stop changing the subject.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-05a.html.text: Katenar: Unfortunately, I do not know everything -- and I cannot tell you everything that I do know. Knowledge can be a burden as well as a key! Know this, then: you and I are both Kamael, but in truth we are different in nature. Confused? Dark Elves may be Elves, but they are not called Elves, are…

links.text: Asks why he wanted to see you.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-06a.html.text: Katenar: I came here at the request of Hierarch Kekropus, who instructed me to reveal to you the secret of the Kamael... Truthfully, I do not know why Kekropus asked me to do so, but I respect his wisdom.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-08a.html.text: Katenar: You already know that our race was created for a specific goal, don't you? I'm sure you have uncovered at least an inkling during your journey. But my information concerns that less than it does how we were created...and by whom.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32235-09a.html.text: Katenar: Ah... If only time permitted, I would like to tell you everything... But it does not, unfortunately, and even now time is growing short. Are you familiar with the word " Spicula ?" Go ask one of my brethren, Harkilgamed about it and listen to his reply... I can speak no more -- I must disa…
